digest.component_or_area: store write path / ticket directory creation
propositions: Directory creation and first event file write race: mkdir(ticket_dir) happens outside the write lock, event file lands at os.replace inside lock, leaving empty dirs if interrupted between mkdir and file write

New staging module creates dir+first event atomically in .tmp-newticket-<pid>-<uuid4> path and publishes via single os.rename under existing write lock, keeping event invisible until rebase guard passes
Temp staging paths (.tmp-*) are dot-prefixed and already excluded from fsck checks without scanner changes, making interrupted writes invisible to MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH scans
Sweep of stale staging dirs (sweep_stale_staging) removes only .tmp-newticket-* owned by dead pids using write-lock v2 stamp, never touches ticket directories or store data, respecting 043f boundary

Batch and reconciler paths (batch_stage_and_commit, inbound_translate._write_event_file, dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT) converted to use staging, and _rollback_batch removes directories published by failed transactions
Lock discipline and concurrency semantics unchanged: rename still happens under write lock, pid+uuid4 naming prevents collisions between concurrent creates
